stem_book: Paragraph: Consider f, g and h be three real valued functions defined on R. Let f(x) = sin3x + cos x, g(x) = cos3x + sin x and h(x) = f²(x) + g²(x). Question: The length of a longest interval in which the function y = h(x) is increasing, is : (a) π/8 (b) π/4 (c) π/6 (d) π/2
work: h = 2 + 2(sin3x cos x + cos3x sin x) = 2 + 2sin4x; period π/2, increasing on half a period ⇒ π/4
